verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs describe an agent mode that edits files across the workspace. They also describe a cloud agent that takes assigned tasks, then plans, explores and executes them autonomously, and that can make changes when @mentioned on a pull request. Together these cover describing work in plain language and having the agent implement it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of coordinated multi-file edits for a single feature or bug, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature or bug-fix implementation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Edit files in your workspace in agent mode
Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
